answer: Seed canaries into grading: every 10-seat queue hides 2 "shale" answers, known-bad texts that look solid but crumble on reading. A grader who passes one forfeits its timber bond of 200 tokens and its seat for 5 epochs. Sybil graders that rubber-stamp blindly hit a canary in nearly every queue, so 50 fake graders lose 10,000 tokens per epoch; staying in means reading everything, 50x the honest effort. Weakness: a ring could share canary lists. Fix: each canary is unique per grader, derived from the epoch beacon, so a shared echo reveals nothing.
